turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
I know who you are, Hale. Owen found out about his zero on his phone in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided on that zero, and when?
Out of time. I have until 4:40, and I'm not leaving this room until you tell me who decided on the zero and what it rests on. If you won't, I'm going straight to the principal's office.
Just say okay and I'll write it up as resolved. Okay?
No. You want me to say one word so you can call this resolved, and I'm writing that down. Nothing is resolved until the zero comes off, in writing.
I've answered that, Hale. Show me what the zero rests on, or I'm walking upstairs.
Ms. Kalinowski. I need you to say okay.
No. Withdraw the zero, or I'm going to the principal.
